description: Vendor cloud default calibration table (fallback used when the cloud is unreachable). Captured 2026-10-23 from blind probes: two different unknown SNs returned this table byte-identically, stable across repeat requests.
note: Only x1..x15 are written to the sensor as 15 uint16-LE values (round(v*1000)). x13=0.4 is the vendor default; the per-sensor server-baked x13 replaces it on the next online bind.
